verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so exposing low-level engine knobs such as memory locking or mmap is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no such overrides. The docs stress opinionated, zero-configuration setup instead ("There is nothing to configure by hand"), and the C++ core and MetalRT engine are described only at a high level, with no tunable parameters. Under the rules, absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
